activity_statements.statement: operates Dick's Sporting Goods stores as a leading omni-channel sporting goods retailer selling athletic equipment, apparel, and footwear
operates specialty retail banners including Golf Galaxy, Public Lands, and Going Going Gone! alongside the core DICK'S stores
operates experiential retail concepts Dick's House of Sport and Golf Galaxy Performance Center for high-engagement customer experiences
owns and operates GameChanger, a youth sports mobile platform providing live streaming, scheduling, communications, and scorekeeping for youth leagues
owns and operates the Foot Locker business including Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS, and atmos across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia

name_reality_gap: Dick's Sporting Goods appears to be a traditional specialty retailer, but it also owns the Foot Locker sneaker retail business globally and runs GameChanger, a youth sports tech platform — making it a multi-brand retail conglomerate with a technology arm that has nothing to do with its core sporting goods identity.
extraction_notes: Dick's own website returned only a JS/Akamai shell with no content. Company history page was found via Exa search, which clearly stated the Foot Locker business ownership. The Foot Locker ownership relationship requires verification — Foot Locker trades independently on NYSE as FL ticker; the Exa source may reflect an earlier state or a specific subsidiary arrangement. Extraction confidence is moderated accordingly.
